events.text: Delia Reed came of age and went looking for work.
Linnet Moss and Wendel Oakes welcomed their first child, Aldric Oakes.
Tamsen Ashdown died of infant illness at age 0.
Godric Juniper founded Godric Juniper's Bakery, investing 2,121 marks.
Osric Alder came of age and went looking for work.
Cressa Juniper was born to Nessa Voss and Anselm Juniper.
Hester Juniper and Lorne Tanner welcomed their first child, Orrin Tanner.
Sabine Penhale came of age and went looking for work.
Yara Moss was born to Fenna Heath and Madoc Moss.
Godric Juniper's Bakery closed: it could no longer pay its workers.
Petra Reed was born to Nora Heath and Wendel Reed.
Anselm Juniper founded Anselm Juniper's Bakery, investing 2,080 marks.
Elowen Gale came of age and went looking for work.
